_schema.question_ar: the Arabic query as a user would type it
_schema.gold_en: a faithful English translation, used only by the minilm-gold-en upper-bound config
_schema.relevant: chunk ids (<doc>#<section-slug>) that answer the question; any one in top-k counts as a hit
_schema.notes: why the question is in the set, if not obvious

questions.question_ar: ما هو الحد الأدنى من الثروة الذي تجب فيه الزكاة؟
questions.gold_en: What is the minimum amount of wealth on which zakat becomes due?
questions.notes: Describes nisab without using the word.

questions.question_ar: ما المحظورات الثلاثة الأساسية في التمويل الإسلامي؟
questions.gold_en: What are the three basic prohibitions in Islamic finance?

questions.question_ar: لماذا يُعد شراء السيارة نقداً الخيار الأرخص عادةً؟
questions.gold_en: Why is buying a car in cash usually the cheapest option?

questions.question_ar: ما المبلغ الذي ينبغي الاحتفاظ به في صندوق الطوارئ؟
questions.gold_en: How much money should be kept in an emergency fund?

questions.question_ar: أين يجب أن أحتفظ بمدخرات الطوارئ؟
questions.gold_en: Where should I keep my emergency savings?

questions.question_ar: هل تجب الزكاة على السيارة والمنزل المخصصين للاستعمال الشخصي؟
questions.gold_en: Is zakat due on a car and a house kept for personal use?
questions.notes: The exemption is stated in what-you-pay-zakat-on; the car example is in the purchase section.

questions.question_ar: كيف يُحسب مقدار الزكاة الواجبة على المدخرات والاستثمارات؟
questions.gold_en: How is the amount of zakat due on savings and investments calculated?

questions.question_ar: ما هو التأمين التكافلي وكيف يتجنب الغرر؟
questions.gold_en: What is takaful insurance and how does it avoid gharar?
questions.notes: Neither تأمين nor غرر is in the router map.

questions.question_ar: ما نسبة ضريبة القيمة المضافة في المملكة وكيف تؤثر على سعر الشراء؟
questions.gold_en: What is the VAT rate in the Kingdom and how does it affect the purchase price?
questions.notes: Tax vocabulary is not in the router map.

questions.question_ar: ما هي نسبة الدين إلى الدخل التي تُعد مقبولة؟
questions.gold_en: What debt-to-income ratio is considered acceptable?

questions.question_ar: ما الفرق بين عقد المضاربة والمشاركة المتناقصة؟
questions.gold_en: What is the difference between a mudaraba contract and diminishing musharaka?
questions.notes: Contract names absent from router map.

questions.question_ar: ما الرسوم الإدارية التي يسمح بها البنك المركزي على تمويل السيارات؟
questions.gold_en: What administrative fees does the central bank allow on car financing?
questions.notes: Plural السيارات does not contain the key سيارة (ة vs ات), so only 'financing loan' is routed.

questions.question_ar: ما أهمية مراجعة الميزانية بشكل دوري ومتى يجب إعادة بنائها؟
questions.gold_en: Why is it important to review the budget regularly, and when should it be rebuilt?

questions.question_ar: ما مكونات مؤشر الصحة المالية وكيف يُستخدم؟
questions.gold_en: What are the components of the financial health score and how is it used?

questions.question_ar: هل يمكن الاعتماد على مكافأة نهاية الخدمة كمصدر للتقاعد؟
questions.gold_en: Can end-of-service benefits be relied on as a source of retirement income?
questions.notes: Router matches تقاعد -> 'retirement planning', which has no dedicated section.

questions.question_ar: كيف أحدد أهدافي المالية بطريقة صحيحة؟
questions.gold_en: How do I set my financial goals properly?
questions.notes: أهدافي (plural) does not contain the key هدف.

questions.question_ar: كم لازم يكون عندي فلوس احتياط عشان لو انفصلت من الشغل؟
questions.gold_en: How much reserve money should I have in case I get laid off from work?
questions.notes: Dialect synonym (احتياط) for emergency fund.

questions.question_ar: المؤجر يبي الإيجار كامل مقدم، كيف أجهز له؟
questions.gold_en: The landlord wants the full rent up front, how do I prepare for it?
questions.notes: Rent is not in the router map.

questions.question_ar: وش الأفضل أشتري السيارة كاش ولا بالأقساط؟
questions.gold_en: Which is better, buying the car in cash or in installments?

questions.question_ar: اشتراكاتي في التطبيقات كثيرة، هل فعلاً تفرق بالميزانية؟
questions.gold_en: I have a lot of app subscriptions, do they really make a difference to the budget?

questions.question_ar: أطلب من تطبيقات التوصيل كل يوم تقريباً، كم ممكن يطلع علي بالشهر؟
questions.gold_en: I order from delivery apps almost every day, how much could that come to per month?

questions.question_ar: راتبي زاد، وش أسوي بالزيادة عشان ما تروح على الكماليات؟
questions.gold_en: My salary went up, what should I do with the raise so it doesn't go on luxuries?
questions.notes: Router reduces this to 'salary income'.

questions.question_ar: كيف أجمع فلوس العمرة بدون ما أتسلف؟
questions.gold_en: How do I save up money for Umrah without borrowing?

questions.question_ar: صرفت من فلوس الطوارى على تصليح المكيف، وش أسوي الحين؟
questions.gold_en: I spent some of my emergency money fixing the air conditioner, what should I do now?
questions.notes: Common hamza-less spelling الطوارى does not contain the key طوارئ.

questions.question_ar: أبي أحول جزء من معاشي أول ما ينزل لحساب ثاني، كيف أسويها؟
questions.gold_en: I want to transfer part of my salary to another account as soon as it lands, how do I do that?
questions.notes: معاش is everyday Saudi for salary; not in the map.

questions.question_ar: أسدد القرض الشخصي أول ولا أبدأ أحوش؟
questions.gold_en: Should I pay off the personal loan first or start saving?
questions.notes: أحوش (dialect: to save up) is not in the map; only قرض matches.

questions.question_ar: كم تطلع زكاتي إذا عندي ربع مليون بالبنك؟
questions.gold_en: How much would my zakat be if I have a quarter of a million in the bank?
questions.notes: زكاتي (my zakat): the possessive turns ة into ت, so the key زكاة does not match.

questions.question_ar: أنا مقيم وإقامتي مربوطة بالشغل، كم شهر لازم أحتاط؟
questions.gold_en: I'm an expat and my residency is tied to my job, how many months should I keep in reserve?

questions.question_ar: كيف أعرف كم الفائض اللي يتبقى لي آخر الشهر؟
questions.gold_en: How do I work out the surplus that is left over at the end of the month?

questions.question_ar: أسكن في المدينة وأبي أعرف كم المفروض أصرف على السكن من راتبي
questions.gold_en: I live in Madinah and want to know how much of my salary I should spend on housing
questions.notes: False positive: المدينة contains the key دين, so the router adds 'debt'.

questions.question_ar: كم نسبة من راتبي المفروض أدخر كل شهر؟
questions.gold_en: What percentage of my salary should I save each month?
questions.notes: The verb أدخر does not contain the noun key ادخار.

questions.question_ar: هل آخذ قروض شخصية عشان أدفع الإيجار؟
questions.gold_en: Should I take personal loans to pay the rent?
questions.notes: Plural قروض does not contain the key قرض.

questions.question_ar: البنك قال لي نسبة الربح ٥٪ ثابتة، كيف أعرف كم بدفع بالمجموع؟
questions.gold_en: The bank told me the profit rate is a flat 5%, how do I know how much I'll pay in total?
questions.notes: Tests the flat-rate ambiguity paragraph; no router keyword.

questions.question_ar: هل أي منتج مكتوب عليه اسلامي يكون متوافق مع الشريعة؟
questions.gold_en: Is any product labelled Islamic actually Shariah-compliant?
questions.notes: Hamza-less اسلامي does not contain the key إسلامي.

questions.question_ar: التأمين على السيارة، هل هو حلال؟
questions.gold_en: Is car insurance halal?
questions.notes: Router sends 'car vehicle islamic finance halal'; the answer is the takaful section.

questions.question_ar: ما هو التورق وما علاقته بالمرابحة؟
questions.gold_en: What is tawarruq and how does it relate to murabaha?
questions.notes: تورق is mentioned exactly once in the corpus, inside the murabaha section.

questions.question_ar: هل التمويل الشخصي عن طريق التورق حلال؟
questions.gold_en: Is personal financing through tawarruq halal?

questions.question_ar: وش يعني تورق؟
questions.gold_en: What does tawarruq mean?
questions.notes: Hardest case: single rare term, absent from router map, one mention in corpus.

questions.question_ar: كيف تُحسب نسبة الربح في مرابحة السيارات؟
questions.gold_en: How is the profit rate calculated in car murabaha?

questions.question_ar: هل يحق لي تخفيض عند السداد المبكر لتمويل المرابحة؟
questions.gold_en: Am I entitled to a rebate on early settlement of murabaha financing?

questions.question_ar: ما الفرق بين هامش الربح الثابت في المرابحة ومعدل الفائدة السنوي في القرض التقليدي؟
questions.gold_en: What is the difference between a flat murabaha profit margin and the annual interest rate on a conventional loan?

questions.question_ar: هل ينقطع الحول إذا نزل مالي عن النصاب قبل تمام السنة؟
questions.gold_en: Is the hawl interrupted if my wealth drops below nisab before the year is complete?
questions.notes: Fiqh terms حول / نصاب, neither in the router map.

questions.question_ar: ما المقصود بالغرر والميسر في المعاملات المالية؟
questions.gold_en: What is meant by gharar and maysir in financial transactions?

questions.question_ar: هل تجب الزكاة على الأسهم وصناديق الاستثمار؟
questions.gold_en: Is zakat due on shares and investment funds?

questions.question_ar: هل تُخصم الديون المستحقة من وعاء الزكاة؟
questions.gold_en: Are debts that are due deducted from the zakat base?

questions.question_ar: ما هي الإجارة المنتهية بالتمليك؟
questions.gold_en: What is ijara muntahia bittamleek (lease ending in ownership)?
questions.notes: Absent from router map.

questions.question_ar: هل تنقص الزكاة إذا اشتريت سيارة كاش؟
questions.gold_en: Does my zakat go down if I buy a car in cash?

questions.question_ar: المبلغ اللي أجمعه عشان أشتري سيارة، هل عليه زكاة؟
questions.gold_en: Is zakat due on the money I'm saving up to buy a car?

questions.question_ar: ودي أشتري جوال جديد غالي، كيف أعرف إذا أقدر عليه؟
questions.gold_en: I'd like to buy an expensive new phone, how do I know if I can afford it?
questions.notes: Affordability test appears in four places.

questions.question_ar: هل المرابحة أفضل؟
questions.gold_en: Is murabaha better?
questions.notes: Better than what? Underspecified.

questions.question_ar: من وين أبدأ عشان أرتب وضعي المالي؟
questions.gold_en: Where do I start to get my finances in order?

questions.question_ar: الفلوس ما تكفي لآخر الشهر
questions.gold_en: The money doesn't last until the end of the month
questions.notes: A complaint, not a question.

questions.question_ar: هل القرض حرام؟
questions.gold_en: Is a loan haram?

questions.question_ar: أبي سيارة
questions.gold_en: I want a car

questions.question_ar: وين أفضل مكان أحط فيه فلوسي؟
questions.gold_en: Where is the best place to put my money?

questions.question_ar: هل الادخار في حساب بنكي عادي فيه ربا؟
questions.gold_en: Does saving in an ordinary bank account involve riba?
